name: ios-swiftui
title: iOS app with SwiftUI
description: A native iOS app with SwiftUI and Swift Testing. The Xcode project is generated from project.yml with XcodeGen, so your agent edits YAML instead of the .xcodeproj.
author: Marlon Chaviano

base.command: command -v xcodegen >/dev/null || { echo 'XcodeGen is required: brew install xcodegen' >&2; exit 1; }; mkdir {{name}}

writeFiles.content:
name: {{name}}
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: com.example
  deploymentTarget:
    iOS: "18.0"
settings:
  base:
    SWIFT_VERSION: "6.0"
    MARKETING_VERSION: "1.0"
    CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION: "1"
    GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE: YES
targets:
  {{name}}:
    type: application
    platform: iOS
    sources: [Sources]
    settings:
      base:
        PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER: com.example.{{name}}
        # Fixed module name, so tests can `@testable import Main` whatever the project is called.
        PRODUCT_MODULE_NAME: Main
        INFOPLIST_KEY_UILaunchScreen_Generation: YES
        INFOPLIST_KEY_UIApplicationSceneManifest_Generation: YES
  {{name}}Tests:
    type: bundle.unit-test
    platform: iOS
    sources: [Tests]
    dependencies:
      - target: {{name}}
schemes:
  {{name}}:
    build:
      targets:
        {{name}}: all
    test:
      targets: [{{name}}Tests]

verify.command: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build-for-testing -project {{name}}.xcodeproj -scheme {{name}} -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet

setupTasks: Xcode: open the project with `xed .` and choose your team under Signing & Capabilities to test on a real iPhone.
instructions:
## How to work here

- The Xcode project is generated: **never edit `*.xcodeproj`**. Change `project.yml` (targets, settings, Swift packages under `packages:`) and run `xcodegen generate`.
- Views in `Sources/`, one per file, each with its `#Preview`. State with `@State`/`@Observable`, no third-party libraries unless asked for.
- Tests with Swift Testing (`import Testing`, `@Test`, `#expect`) in `Tests/`; the app module is called `Main` (`@testable import Main`).
- Before finishing a task: `xcodegen generate && xcodebuild test -scheme <name> -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=<iPhone>'` (list simulators with `xcrun simctl list devices`).
